gaps.explanation: Statement Exhibit H (trimmed p8, accrual): Total operating revenues 1,031,314 (Electric 760,101, Water 184,774, Sewer 86,439) + Interest income 761 (Electric) = 1,032,075. Business-type detail = Schedule 8 (trimmed p17, Cash Receipts and Disbursements Compared to Budget, budgetary cash basis) per-fund receipts: Electric 762,790 = detail[113], Water 184,488 = detail[114], Sewer 86,021 = detail[115]; total 1,033,299. Schedule 7 (trimmed p16) reconciles them: Receipts Accrual Basis Electric 760,862 / Water 184,774 / Sewer 86,439 (= 1,032,075) and (Increase)/Decrease for accruals receivables 1,928 / (286) / (418) = 1,224 = the gap. The Exhibit H rows' money is already inside the printed Schedule 8 fund totals (not splittable), so adding them would double count. Cash vs accrual basis; no fix.

Statement Exhibit H (p8): Total operating expenses 748,493 (Electric 517,035, Water 137,544, Sewer 93,914, incl. Depreciation and amortization 143,798) + Interest expense and fees 28,508 (4,678 / 21,024 / 2,806) = 777,001. Detail = Schedule 8 (p17) cash disbursements Electric 740,041 = detail[116], Water 184,367 = detail[117], Sewer 86,021 = detail[118]; total 1,010,429. Schedule 7 (p16) prints the bridge per fund: Disbursements Accrual Basis Electric 727,378 (= 517,035 + 4,678 + Transfers to other funds 205,665), Water 158,568 (= 137,544 + 21,024), Sewer 96,720 (= 93,914 + 2,806); adjustments Dec(Inc) payables 6,638 / (2,110) / (21,973), Due to/from 24,364 / 0 / (24,364), Depreciation/Fixed assets (43,339) / (61,663) / 9,704, Debt Princ/Interest/Etc. 25,000 / 89,572 / 25,934; = cash 740,041 / 184,367 / 86,021. Gap: 777,001 - 1,010,429 = -233,428 = -(205,665 - 17,445 - 95,298 + 140,506). The Exhibit H per-fund rows are already inside the printed Schedule 8 fund totals (one amount per fund, not splittable, not a true duplicate), so they cannot be added. No fix.

Exhibit H (p8) prints 'Transfers to other funds' Electric Fund (205,665), Water 0, Sewer 0, Totals 2024 (205,665) = JSON business_type.transfers_net. Schedule 7 (p16) shows Electric Disbursements Accrual Basis 727,378 = 517,035 + 4,678 + 205,665, carried into Disbursements Cash Basis 740,041, which is the Schedule 8 (p17) Electric line already in detail (detail[116]). The pass 2 proposal to add Electric Transfers Out -205,665 was held for that reason: adding it would count the 205,665 twice. The printed 740,041 cannot be split. No fix.
